I'm just adding some finishing touches and hopefully will make an Update Trailer for it as well.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all I have to report for now, but some major content is coming soon, and some new projects will begin forming![/p][p][/p][p]Catch ya later in the Corruption,[/p][p]  Lyvri.[/p]

notes.title: Update v1.1.9.1
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]So sorry for the delay on this simple update, I've been spending a bit of time working on a Google Play release. But, v1.1.9.1 is finally out! Here's a simplified list of the changes:[/p][list][*][p]Base Game has more enemies in some levels to balance out the new changes to the pacing of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Endless Mode enemy milestones and achievements have been more spread out to match the new score update (previously obtained achievements haven't been re-locked.)[/p][/*][*][p]Some achievements titles/descriptions have been rewritten.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new ShipType for unlocking the Endless Mode's 'Magmanificent!!!' achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized Endless Mode score milestones to now check whenever the score increases; not formerly every frame.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck's resolution [i]should[/i] now be 1280x800 by default.[/p][/*][*][p]The On-Screen Keyboard now appears when selecting a text box on Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Other fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, the full patch logs are in-game.[/p][p][/p][p]Hopefully the next update will be much quicker, whether it be v1.1.9.5 or the v2.0.0 update. Either way, big stuff is coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]See you then, [/p][p]Lyvri.[/p]

notes.title: Pellet Dodge Google Play Version Releasing Soon... Help Needed!
notes.notes: [h1]Hello Everyone![/h1][p]  First of all, thank you for purchasing and playing Pellet Dodge. It means the world to me that you're supporting me and possibly even enjoying my work that's taken a good chunk of my life to work on! [/p][p]Thanks to that, a new milestone of this game's life has been reached; an official Google Play Andoid release! However, it isn't exactly as easy as Steam's submission process is, since to even [i]begin [/i]working on anything behind the scenes in Google Play Console, you need to first perform a Closed Test.[/p][p][/p][h1]That's great! How can I help?[/h1][p]  Well, this is where YOU come in! I need testers for this Test, and what better place to find them is right here with people who already know the game! If you're interested, please fill out this [url="https://forms.gle/RXPhHtQg1dRimuvD9"]this Google Form[/url] to submit a request for access to the test.[/p][p]Since this whole process is manual, replies may take time, and keep in mind that space [b]is[/b] [b]limited[/b] to 100 users, so act fast if you want to participate![/p]

notes.title: Dev Update - 4/30/25
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, hope you all are doing well.

[h1]v1.1.9.1 Progress[/h1]
Despite burnout, progress is being done. v1.1.9.1 is going to feature:
[list]
[*]some bug fixes
[*]Quality of Life improvements
[*]support for upcoming DLC (wink, blink)
[*]and improve the Steam Deck experience (on-screen keyboard will soon automatically appear when typing in input boxes and the game will [i]actually[/i] render the game in 1280x800 instead of it defaulting to 1280x720 for some reason.
[/list]
This update [i]should[/i] come out some time in May, but it's also going to be a very busy month for me between my birthday coming up and some academic events. Nevertheless, the update is coming out, and there will be more to come in the near future that won't be next year.

[h1]The Future[/h1]
As always; here's a reminder that [b]when v2.0 rolls out, the base price will go from USD$4.99 to USD$7.99[/b] due to a severe increase in content. Now that that's out of the way, I want to talk about some new projects.

[h1]New Games Coming Soon![/h1]
[i]I'm excited to (really early) announce these games I'm working on that will hopefully have a home on Steam when they're ready to release![/i]

[h2]My Amazing Life as a Shoe Disposer![/h2]
In this comedy horror, you'll be a typical citizen with the amazing career of being a disposer of used and old shoes (you eat them. yes. EAT. it's totally fine for your health.) It's amazing! In this game, you'll live though your amazing life and throw parties to share the awesomeness. 
In terms of development, prototyping has begun. There's a player-controller and a base house with a working door, but the groundwork for a basic alpha is there and shouldn't take long.

[h2]Primaldemic[/h2]
Primaldemic is an open-world realtime action RPG gacha game where the gacha is optional. You can also directly buy characters at any time. 
(They're discounted during their banner. 6-star characters are slightly OP, and can only be extremely rarely obtained from gacha.) Premium currency will use our standard pricing (cheap; USD$0.99 for 2 pulls worth, 10 pull is $3.99, and a guarunteed 5-star at 60 pulls would be about USD$14.99. About those pulls, your banner 5-star is always guarunteed once you hit 100 pulls. More details to be determined later.

In this game, you'll stop a plague that was caused by a rouge scientist as a bandage-cure for an unknown disease that wasn't nearly ready for the public. Side effects are turning ghoul-like and increased strength. Mutations may occur on severe overdosage.

In terms of development; it's in the planning phase. No prototype just yet, just a document for planned stuff and some soundtrack (yes I make songs for my games that don't even exist yet.) which you can listen to [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ews0rLzJ0WZbcUzO753sEKZqlzsLTuw8?usp=sharing]here.[/url]

[h2]MysticalDevelopers Legacy Remastered Collection[/h2]
A full redesign of my old Scratch games are going to be remade in Unity. This collection will include:
[list]
[*]Pellet Dodge: Classic: Remastered
[*]Pellet Shoot: Remastered
[*]Milk Drinking Simulator: Remastered
[/list]
Each game will have redone graphics and improved gameplay that expands but stays true to the original content. This may or may not be a paid bundle. Development not started at this time.


Thanks to everyone who's enjoying my games, and I hope you'll stick around to see what'll be new in store in the future!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey #274!

  This is regular contact on what's going on since updates are slower than ever.

[h1]What's coming:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Endless Mode 2.0 - New score system and minibosses with Endless-exclusive rewards.
[*]Leaderboards will now use Steam (mobile and upcoming console versions will use something else, unless Valve one day adds cross-platform support for Steamworks services.)
[/list]

[h1]What's the hold-up??[/h1]
Short answer: Burnout. The worst enemy to all types of creators. I've just generally lost my motivation to do much in the Editor at the moment, since I've had to stare at pretty much the same stuff since 2021 (Wow, we're coming up to 4 years of total 'active' development!) so that takes a toll on how much you want to keep staring. The updates aren't difficult for me to do, they just honestly bore me. 

[h1]So, what about it?[/h1]
1) Rude. 2) I'm gonna try my quickest to leave Pellet Dodge off at a state that I can fully leave complete and be satisfied about it, while still having things I could possibly do to improve the game experience, or even do DLC. That'll be my end goal; to make a great v2.0.0. Then, after that, onto newer projects for the time being. So I can improve my skills and regain that excitement to learn something new about the project I'm working on. I've already got two 3D games in mind that I want to make that'll hopefully also be here on Steam. Please look forward to them, as I will be looking forward to developing them and experiencing your playthroughs when they're playable.

Hello everyone!

This update overhauls the Settings menu for a better experience visually and has better controller support, as well as fixes and improves some stuff!

notes.title: Update v1.1.8 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello all Ship #274s! Thanks for traversing the void of Space to save us from the Corruption. Some things have changed with the timeline The following is the most important:

- The stars now look different
- You will be acknowledged for your Achievements
- Enemy behavior has changed. They now seem to be mindful if there are multiple Ships now...

...as well as some other changes. (The full patch notes can be viewed in-game.)

As we get closer to v2.0 (or v1.2, which I am making a leap) I want to thank everyone for everything! v2.0 is going to be a [b]MASSIVE[/b] content update with so much. With that, it's important to note that [b]the game's price will increase from USD$4.99 to $7.99[/b]. Another thing to note is that v2.0 probably (and hopefully) won't be the last update to PD ever. After v2.0, I'm going to be taking a hiatus from PD to work on a new game. PD will still get smaller updates from time to time. After the new game at least has a playable Alpha or Beta, PD development could take off again. Until then, I think you'll like what I have in store for the near future! ;) Anyways, as always, I want to thank everyone so much for playing my game and I hope you all stick around to see me and my projects grow. Maybe one day I'll make the top charts! Haha, one can dream, but again thank you all so much! Every single player, no matter the number, means so much to me.

notes.title: Update 1.1.7 - [EXPERIMENTAL] Mac Support is here!
notes.notes: Hey everyone! Thanks for playing PD! I've updated the game with some fixes and improvements, as well as added some Mac support for testing. It's experimental since when I had a friend test, their colors were really dark and nothing had transparency which took up a lot of screen space. So, hopefully that was just a specific thing and wont happen on your Macs, but if they do, please send me an email at pelletdodge.dev@gmail.com and tell me about it so I can fix it ASAP!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 now out!
notes.notes:
Thanks for checking out Pellet Dodge! After a long time of hard work, here's some of the things that's changed in this version:

- Save Files have been redone to now save in physical files, which now allows Steam Cloud to be supported.
- The Linux graphics API is now Vulkan by default to preserve battery life for the Steam Deck.
- The Steam Deck's keyboard [i]should[/i] now automatically appear when selecting an InputField.
- A lot of new and reaaaalllly old bugs have been finally fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Small Fixes... for now
notes.notes:
Some big updates are yet to come, but for now is some small changes to improve the game experience.
[list]
[*] The UI and in-game camera has been improved for 4:3 displays
[*] Improved the pre-open-world areas of the CyberRyft to be one level
[*] Decreased the Area 10 Boss' difficulty
[*] The Pre-Release Main Menu theme has been added to the options of Menu music.
[/list]

Thanks for checking out Pellet Dodge, and we'll have more impressive updates later on.
